shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 3 'editor|markdown|textarea|form' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,180p' src/main.tsx && rg -n 'hallucination|TextArea|Markdown' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor useMarkdownEditor MarkdownEditorView && node -e \"for(const p of ['@gravity-ui/markdown-editor','@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/components']) console.log(p,require('./node_modules/'+p+'/package.json').version)\" && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md | head -180 && rg -n -C 3 'useMarkdownEditor|MarkdownEditorView|styles|peerDependencies|Example|initial|markdown' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -220"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh markdown-editor useMarkdownEditor MarkdownEditorView; node -e \"for(const p of ['@gravity-ui/markdown-editor','@gravity-ui/uikit','@gravity-ui/components']) console.log(p,require('./node_modules/'+p+'/package.json').version)\"; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md; rg -n -C 3 'useMarkdownEditor|MarkdownEditorView|styles|peerDependencies|Example|initial|markdown' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/dist/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -220"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/docs/guides/how-to-add-editor-with-create-react-app.md | head -150; rg -n 'initial|value|onChange|on.*change|placeholder|allowHTML|interface MarkdownEditorView|stickyToolbar|className' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/useMarkdownEditor.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/*.d.ts | head -160; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | rg -n -C 3 'peerDependencies|style|css'; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor | rg '\\.css"'$'"' | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'export declare const TextInput|interface TextInputProps|export.*ButtonProps|type ButtonProps|export.*TextProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -120; npm ls --depth=0"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'base-generic|line-generic|Text variant|display-2|subheader-2|Flex|gap|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/typography.md | head -200; git status --short; git diff --stat; git diff -- package.json src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/App.css"
